set.body:
Phase B (assurance floor). Companion to Phase C — C fixes the protocol, B3 proves it.

Current tests are same-JVM fibers on a local filesystem, which cannot exercise the cross-process races the kernel claims to survive. Worse, the existing claim race moves ONE source toward DIFFERENT destinations; it never tests competing publishers targeting the SAME destination.

Note the striped process-local monitor at kernel/AtomicFiles.scala:31/178-181 is by construction invisible to a same-JVM test that it itself serializes — the sidecar advisory lock is the only thing standing between two PROCESSES, and nothing currently tests it.

Fix:
- Separate-JVM collision tests: N processes racing publishOnce, writeNew, writeStable and claim against one destination.
- Assert exactly one winner and typed loser classification, not merely absence of corruption.
- Record which guarantees hold on which filesystem (local APFS/ext4 vs NFS/Lustre) as evidence for Phase C3's per-consumer qualification.
set.title: P8.B3: Separate-JVM atomic publication collision tests
